message: 一緒に並んで
Grade rankings, announced--

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggggh...」
The area in front of the bulletin board is packed with students.
Rankings for each grade are posted, and cheers of joy and groans of disappointment erupt all around.

name: Misa
message: 「To think it would end with results like this!」
Ever since enrolling at Ryuusei Academy up until today, the top two spots have always been the same.
That's why, just from seeing the text change, it leaves a completely different impression.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura―kun is fourth, and I'm fifth. For once, the two of us―」

name: Synn
message: 「Goodbye, Misa... It was fun while it lasted...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right, I won't say goodbye. Just... don't forget about me...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's wrong, Sakura-kun?」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp?! Don't tell me you're going in for brain surgery or something?! Why didn't you say a single word to me?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Misa-chan? Normally, in a situation like this, you'd ask, 'Are you transferring schools?' you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「T-T-T-T-Transferring?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「He ain't. There's no way Synn-sama's got the dough to move away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa... Even if I get expelled, I'll still be around Ryuusei Town for a little while.」

name: Misa
message: 「E-Expelled, you say?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know you'll be busy with all sorts of things, but grab a meal with me every now and then, and tell me how everyone on the Student Council is doing... *sniff*, *sob*...」

name: Synn
message: 「Farewell, my sparkling, shining academy life」

name: Synn
message: 「Though considering I was constantly getting scolded by Misa, it's seriously doubtful whether it was actually sparkling... *sniff*...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura―kun, calm down! If you can't pay your tuition, I'll ask Father to scrape together the funds―」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama's a scholarship student, y'know? Obviously his tuition's completely waived, ain't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But, I'm already... already... *sob*, *sniffle*!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, since you've been running away with the top spot until now, I came over wondering if this might happen... Synn-chan really did get the wrong idea, didn't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「You don't always have to be at the very top to keep your scholarship privileges, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Buh? Id dad true?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, your face is a total mess from crying! How pathetic」

name: Misa
message: 「Here, a handkerchief! Rub, rub, rub」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph, mmph, mmph」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, blow」

name: Synn
message: 「B-bud... Misa's hadgerchief will ged dirty...」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't care if it gets dirty, just hurry up and do it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Honk, snort-snort」

name: Misa
message: 「There, all done... whew」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks. Let me borrow that handkerchief. I'll wash it and give it back」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude! Even I know how to do laundry, you know」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, that's not what he meant, man?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufufu, I wonder if this school has ever had a president and vice president as in sync as you two?」

name: Helena
message: 「At the very least, your bond in the Student Council runs deeper than it did in Ria's and my generation」

name: Helena
message: 「Expelling Synn-kun here would be completely out of the question」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Thank goodness~」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, I won't let you quit! Our match still hasn't been settled yet, after all!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ho-we-ver\s04 You might be in trouble if you don't take the top spot next time, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll take that to heart」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! Now then, let me present this to the two of you」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, next I have to go see Ria while she's studying at home. Haa, so busy, so busy」
Wiggling all ten fingers seductively, Helena-san charges straight toward the Kujou residence.
Third-years don't have exams anymore. She's probably going to praise Ria-senpai for studying on her own and celebrate with her like always.

name: Misa
message: 「Heeheehee.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, it's a shame our ranks dropped, but nobody came between you and me, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「...? That's nothing to brag about, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's that supposed to mean! Are you saying you hate being ranked right next to me?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that--I mean our grades dropping.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa, let's have study sessions every now and then from now on. We only got to do it for a few days this time, but I still got a ton done.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-If it's with you, Sakura-kun, then I...」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, fine, you leave me no choice. I'll keep you company from now on.」

name: Shio
message: 「Aah~~. Sneak, sneak.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, why are you avoiding me?」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Avoiding you makes it sound so scandalous. Since it is autumn after all, I simply had the sudden urge to go maple-leaf viewing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, there are plenty of maple trees in the schoolyard. The leaves taste great when you make tempura out of them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, huh? Speaking of maple trees, aren't there tons of them growing at Asukai Shrine?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me... Shio, come here!」

name: Shio
message: 「I respectfully decline! I shall take my leave now!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold it right there!」

name: Shio
message: 「Eek?!」

name: Misa
message: 「What rank did you get? Spill it!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I-I-I-I have the right to remain silent too, you know!」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Sister, please unhand me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, you shouldn't force her.」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph...! It's fine, since I'm your older sister」

name: Shio
message: 「I-It is not fine at all」

name: Misa
message: 「Then let me rephrase the question. Of course you placed in the top 10, right, Shio?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my? Look, an airplane in the sky--」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't try to dodge the question!!」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall go chase after that contrail!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold it right there! So you did badly on your tests, didn't you? Starting tonight, we're studying hard!!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-Is it not unavoidable? I am the heiress to Asukai Shrine, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Training my 'Ki,' never neglecting my shrine maiden arts, and spending my days exterminating the spirits lurking in Ryuusei Town」

name: Shio
message: 「Even if my grades slip a little because of all that, you could just call it part of my charm」

name: Misa
message: 「That's just an excuse!」

name: Misa
message: 「If you say it's unavoidable, then it's also unavoidable for me to stay over in your room starting today and make you study until midnight, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「M-Master Paqy, please stop my sister!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hoh, asking the great me for help instead of Lord Synn--looks like you actually understand how the world works」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then you already know the answer, don't you, little naginata girl?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Give it up」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah, cut down in a single stroke...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hiss, I'm leaving the rest to you」

name: Misa
message: 「If it's a request from Paqy-san, I can't refuse. Come along to the library, Shio」

name: Shio
message: 「Eeeeeek--my sister is dead serioussssss--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Must be nice, listening to smart people talk... *sigh*~」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? How'd you do this time?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe~♪ Nana-chan and I are lined up right next to each other, nice and friendly~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「V-sign!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, the two of you are best friends, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm telling you, that's not it. What Sacchin's peace sign means is--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Our grade rankings are in the bottom double digits! Now that's Sweets Club quality.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't know her, I don't know that kind of quality. I'm forever an average girl.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, President, Treasurer, and Sacchin! Good day to you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Come on, you too, Lolotte! It's V for victory!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「V for victory~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Didn't you guys lose big time?!」
